content: Haiyanai Waiye Xomokaka Tahi
Wiso wikinatere wityakekone kakoa wisaoniterenai atyoite wakahinaehena inira tyakekoterenai, hakolalaha kolatyaha maheta. Maisaiya atyo witahi taita wahekoita.
Nika hoka waihalahalinikisa wihinaehare waiye tyaona maheta, exahe ityakekoneha kekoare maheta.
Hiyaiya, Cristo atyo maisa hatahi taita xini ahekotya. Iraiti Waiyexe atyo exakere nexa:

content.text: Xalijiniharexenai kirawanehenere hiso atyo exoa noheno, nexa.

content: Tyotya kaxairatyakehenere Iraiti Waiyexe nanekoa atyo aotyakisa wiso maheta hoka wimamaxaharenehare watyaha maheta Xekohaseti xahita. Exahe wimamairanehare mokitere Iraiti xairatyoare tyaonitere kakoa maheta.
Kasani Enore, mehexaikohaliti, iyateliti xekasehare kahinaetya xiso hoka waiye xamokakakoa naokita, Jesus Cristo haiyanae waiye mohenere akereta.
Nikare ite hoka xityotya haxawalita xaexakeritya Wiyekohase Jesus Cristo Nexe Enore.
Waiyexe Iraiti Majudeuneharenai Ana
Hatyo hiyeta haiyanae xaohena xomana, Enore kakoa ihalahareha maheta, Cristo aohenere xiso akereta.
Cristo atyo judeunae wakanehare tyaona, Enore katyakekotyaka maheta, exahe hoka Enore toahiya iraehenereharenae enahetakomaniyereharenaeha hiye kaotyaka maheta.
Exahe majudeuneharenae hoka Enore aexakerityaha maheta enawaiyexehare hiyeta. Exakere atyo Iraiti Waiyexe nexa:

content.text: Hiyetaite hoka naexakeritya hiso majudeuneharenae koni, exahe noxaexakiliri kakoaite noxera homana, nexa.

content: Exakere nehitiya Iraiti Waiyexe:

content.text: Xiso majudeuneharenae, maika xihalaharehena Enore haomanere aohenerenae kakoa, Israel hotyalinai kakoa.

content: Exakere tehitiya nexa:

content.text: Xiso majudeuneharenae, xityotya xaexakerehena Xekohaseti. Xityotya xiso haliti hotyalinae xaexakerehenene.

content: Isaías tehitiya nexa:

content.text: Jessé jikolahare ite tyoa. Kaotyakaite hoka majudeuneharenae Xekohase tyaona hoka exahita atyoite atyahaharetyoahenaha.

content: Maika Enore, axatyahanikijiterehare wiso, kalore aihalahalinikisa, amehexaikohalikisa xiso, xityakekoterene hiyeta hoka xiyatyahane heko kekoare Isekohaliti Waiyexe niyatere hiyeta.
Paulo Xawaiyekehalakala
Nohinaeharenai, noxahekoli hiye hoka kalikini ala xawaiyexehare, exahe xawaiyore xoalini hare kakoa, exahe xawaiyore xaotyakisakakoita naoka.
Hoka kalikini exe babera naxairatya nomamairanini kakoa, haiya akiti Iraitinae xotyaxematya maheta Enore iyateliti isehenere nomani hiyeta.

Iyateliti isa nomani Jesus Cristo wakanehare notyaona hoka majudeuneharenae nakahinaetya maheta. Sacerdote akereta atyo notyaonita Waiyexe Iraiti Enore niraene noxakaitere hiyeta. Nikare notyaonita, kasani majudeuneharenae, Enore aokahene haomana efetatyakaharenai akereta naokita, Isekohaliti Waiyexe hiyeta.
Hatyo hiyeta Jesus Cristo kakoa haxawalita notyaonita hoka nahakitere Enore hatene hiyetaite naokowiharetyoahena.
Hiyetaite hoka niraehena Cristo xoalini hare tyomitere nohiyeti tahi akiti taita, majudeuneharenae Enore tyakeko maheta. Hatyoharenai atyo kaomaka Iraiti hiyeta, wenati waiyexe hiyeta,
exahe metaharexe nomaka hiyeta, exahe Enore Nisekohare niyatere xoaha hiyeta. Nikare, Jerusalém nalita, exahe Ilíria nali kijiya, Waiyexe Iraiti noxakaita tyotya Jesus Cristo tahi halitinai hiye.
Naiyateretyoa minita atyo noxakaini Iraiti Waiyexe kakoa haiyanaikoa Cristo tahi masemaneharenai hiye. Maisa noxakai maheta xini koxaka haiyanai xakaihenereharenai hiyeta maheta xini.
Hiyaiya, exakere atyo Iraiti Waiyexe nexa:

content.text: Haiyanae Jesus Cristo tahi masemaneharenae ite waiyehenahene, exahe haiyanae masemanetereharenae etahi ana ite waiyekehalaka.

content: Paulo Xane Waiyeheta Roma Yerenae Aokowi
Kahaliki xakore notyoa nowaiyeheta xiso naokowita hoka maisa aliyakere xaka.
Xakore hoka koxaka tyare atyo nohateni alikoanai namiyatya hoka toahiyita tyare nowaiyeheta naokowita xiso hoka

kalikini atyoite notyoa nowaiyehetehena xiso. Kasani Espanha noxanihenere xowaka nowaiyeheta naokowita xiso, exahe kasani tehitiya xakahinaetya natyo naokita noxanini nali xeta kakoa, nowaiyehetehenere xiso najikinita.
Xakore hoka kalikini atyoite noxanihena Jerusalém xeta Enore kaxaikoneharenai nakahinaetya maheta.
Macedônia, Grécia nali xoaha Enore xema tyaoniterenae ahotyalikisaha xiyehaliti, kahinaetyaha aokowiha Jerusalém nali Enore kaxaikonehare hotyalinai maxiyeharehare tyaoniterenae maheta.

Hatyoahitaha nikare ahekotyaha, nikare terota atyo ehateneha judeunae kahinaetyaha maheta. Hiyaiya, judeunae atyo Enore koamaniya nawenatyaka kakoa kahinaetyaha majudeuneharenae. Hiyeta hoka majudeuneharenae ite kahinaehena judeunae haxiyehareha xoalini hare waiyexe kakoa.
Exe hateniti ite namiyatya, exahe exe ahohisakoahenahere xiyehaliti hotohare ite nisa namiyatya hoka hatyo najikinitaite noxani Espanha xeta hoka notonani heko nowaiyeheta xiso.
Nowaiyehenere xiso xowakaite waiyexe xoalini hare Cristo nalitare kaotyakehena xomana. Hatyoharenae waiyekehalakita nomani.
Naxa xiso, nohinaeharenae, Wiyekohase Jesus Cristo hiyeta, exahe Isekohaliti xawaiyetyati ijitere womana hiyeta. Maika xakahinaetya natyo xiraexala kakoa.
Xiraexatya nomani hoka Judéia nali matyakekoneharenai tyaoniterenae maisa xoana mokita natyo, exahe Enore kaxaikoneharenae Jerusalém naliyerenai hoka nohateni kakoa ihalahareha.
Nikare ite, Enore xaokalita hoka nokaokihena xomana hoka nihalahare, exahe xaihalahalinikisaite natyo.
Maika Enore, mehexaikohaliti ijitere womana, kaxaiko xityotya naoka. Xoaha taita.
